* fix(fiber): port the Portal leak fixes from v10

Portal subscribed to its parent root store inside useMemo and dropped the
unsubscribe, so every unmounted portal stayed in the parent's listeners
with its scene (#3676). Its setEvents closure also read injectState.set at
call time, chaining every replaced portal state (#3751). v10 fixed both in
f71b118 and f8749d7; this applies the same two changes and f8749d7's

* fix(fiber): sync portal with parent changes made before it subscribes

The portal copies the parent state during render but only subscribes in a
layout effect, so parent updates made in between (e.g. by an earlier
sibling's layout effect) were missed until the next parent mutation. Catch
up once after subscribing, only when the parent state changed since the
snapshot.

Also tidy the subscription comment, reference #3676 in its regression test,
and restore the subscribe spy in a finally.

* refactor(fiber): clarify portal lifecycle

Move injection and store initialization to module helpers. Keep the portal store in React state and create setEvents once with its stable setter. Track the last mirrored parent snapshot so Activity can reconnect without missing restored state.

* test(fiber): focus portal coverage on public behavior

Cover parent resizes and local events, changing camera and size overrides, unmount cleanup, target changes, and Activity state preservation. Retain the commit-time synchronization and restored snapshot regressions while removing subscription spies and duplicate scenarios.

fix(fiber): port the Portal leak fixes from v10 (#4030)

* fix(fiber): port the Portal leak fixes from v10

Portal subscribed to its parent root store inside useMemo and dropped the
unsubscribe, so every unmounted portal stayed in the parent's listeners
with its scene (#3676). Its setEvents closure also read injectState.set at
call time, chaining every replaced portal state (#3751). v10 fixed both in
f71b118 and f8749d7; this applies the same two changes and f8749d7's
regression tests to master.

* fix(fiber): sync portal with parent changes made before it subscribes

The portal copies the parent state during render but only subscribes in a
layout effect, so parent updates made in between (e.g. by an earlier
sibling's layout effect) were missed until the next parent mutation. Catch
up once after subscribing, only when the parent state changed since the
snapshot.

Also tidy the subscription comment, reference #3676 in its regression test,
and restore the subscribe spy in a finally.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(fiber): clarify portal lifecycle

Move injection and store initialization to module helpers. Keep the portal store in React state and create setEvents once with its stable setter. Track the last mirrored parent snapshot so Activity can reconnect without missing restored state.

* test(fiber): focus portal coverage on public behavior

Cover parent resizes and local events, changing camera and size overrides, unmount cleanup, target changes, and Activity state preservation. Retain the commit-time synchronization and restored snapshot regressions while removing subscription spies and duplicate scenarios.
